description: AI lists as graphs (context/designs/modding/ai-list-graphs.md): the two simulant commands run through their graph twins. A Combat match on Car Park with 12 simulants for 90 s: the stage's background list 0x1000 runs mp_init_simulants (the whole wave completes), simulants kill and die, and each dead simulant runs global list 0x0028, whose if_bot_respawning goes on while it waits (branch=0) and jumps to label 0x16 once it has respawned (branch=1).

input_sequence.comment: Pause until the local player of the Car Park match is spawned and live.
90 s of play: kills, deaths and respawns among the 12 simulants

required_lines: SCENARIO\.GRAPH: AI simulant commands '[^']+' if_bot_respawning=1 mp_init_simulants=1 backend=graph\.ai\.simulant
SCENARIO\.GRAPH: AI action mp_init_simulants wave=complete source=
SCENARIO\.GRAPH: AI condition if_bot_respawning chr=[0-9]+ simulant=1 label=22 branch=0
SCENARIO\.GRAPH: AI condition if_bot_respawning chr=[0-9]+ simulant=1 label=22 branch=1
forbidden_patterns: missing executable AI simulant source nodes
